name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.68.7: Keep the radio's airtime trend across a restart.
changelog.v2.68.6: Give the scroll rail a gutter of its own beside a list's cards.
changelog.v2.68.5: Widen the framebuffer size multiply before it overflows.
changelog.v2.68.4: Keep a card's inset out of a heading's room at the smallest scale; Give the node detail's cards room to be cards.
changelog.v2.68.3: Say why an assetless release cannot be installed; Stop an up-to-date radio reporting the installer as unbuilt.
